content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the ESIC Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download ESIC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 28 vacancies are available - 1 for Part Time Specialist / Full Time Specialist, 1 for Part Time Specialist (Dentistry), 1 for Part Time Specialist (Radiology), 1 for Part Time Specialist (Ophthalmology), 1 for Part Time Specialist (Psychiatry), 1 for Part Time Specialist (General Medicine), 1 for Full Time Specialist (General Medicine), 1 for Full Time Specialist (Orthopaedics), 2 for Full Time Specialist (Anaesthesiology), 1 for Full Time Specialist (Dentistry (Endodontist)), 1 for Full Time Specialist (Radiology), 1 for Full Time Specialist (Ophthalmology), 1 for Full Time Specialist (Psychiatry), 1 for Full Time Specialist (General Surgery), 4 for Senior Resident (03 Year), 3 for Senior Resident (03 Year) (Obstetrics & Gynaecology), 2 for Senior Resident (03 Year) (Orthopaedics), 2 for Senior Resident (03 Year) (Radiology), and 2 for Senior Resident (03 Year) (General Surgery).

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Part Time Specialist / Full Time Specialist: MBBS with PG Degree or Diploma or Equivalent in concerned specialty from Recognized University with 3 years experience after acquiring PG Degree OR minimum of 5 years experience after Graduate Diploma. For Endodontics, PG Degree (MDS) in Endodontics specialty from Recognized University with 3 Years experience is required. Senior Resident (03 Year): MBBS with PG Degree or Diploma or Equivalent in concerned specialty from Recognized University. For some posts, MBBS Doctors with two years of experience out of which one year of experience in General Medicine/ General Surgery from Government hospital/ private hospital (not a private clinic) can be selected. Senior Resident (01 Year): MBBS Degree from NMC recognized Medical College / Institution with two years experience out of which 1 year of experience in General medicine / General Surgery from Govt. Hospital/ Private Hospital, (not a private clinic). Candidate must have completed Compulsory Rotatory Residential Internship and must produce internship completion certificate at the time of interview. Should have registered with NMC or Tamil Nadu State Medical Council.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Part Time Specialist / Full Time Specialist: Maximum age is 67 years. Age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Ex-serviceman as per rules. Senior Resident (03 Year): Maximum age is 45 years. Age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Ex-serviceman as per rules. Senior Resident (01 Year): Maximum age is 30 years. Age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Ex-serviceman as per rules (No age relaxation for unreserved vacancies). To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview registration is scheduled for 18 August 2026. Candidates should report between 09:00 AM and 10:30 AM on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total number of vacancies announced by ESIC?
faq.answer: ESIC has announced a total of 22 vacancies for the posts of Specialist and Senior Resident.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for these ESIC posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is MBBS with a PG Degree or Diploma or equivalent in the concerned specialty from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for Specialist posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Specialist posts is 67 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Senior Resident (03 Year) posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration for Senior Resident (03 Year) posts is Rs. 1,42,514/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this ESIC recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the ESIC hospital located for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The ESIC hospital is located in Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 627003.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates need to bring original and self-attested photocopies of Matriculation certificate, MBBS, Diploma/Degree certificate, SC/ST/OBC certificate, registration certificate, experience certificate, and two passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for ESIC recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for ESIC Specialist and Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview.
